Alex: Heads-up: Prod inference pool r32-52 started throwing OOMs around 10:15 UTC. Symptoms look like allocator fragmentation after the kernel selection tweak.
Maria: Any perf traces yet? what changed in the kernel selector?
Alex: We landed a heuristic to prefer fused attention kernels for seq_len>1024. Telemetry shows more large workspace allocations per request.
Jen: OOMs correlate with long-chat sessions + cache misses. KV cache eviction pattern looks off.
Sam: Can you paste allocator stats from the worker that OOM'd? low/no personally-identifying info please.
Alex: Sure, from the failing replica:
```
Allocator peak: 31.7 GiB
Active blocks: 1223
Free fragments: 438
Largest free: 120 MiB
Workspace requested: 384 MiB
Total GPU mem: 32.0 GiB
```
Kai: That largest free being ~120MiB screams fragmentation. Large workspace requests (384MiB) can't be satisfied even though total free ~= 3.2 GiB across many fragments.
Maria: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Route heavy seq_len requests to a fallback quantized model (smaller workspace), 2) Enable circuit breaker for queue length/token size, 3) shrink workspace/reserve size on current kernel.
Jen: For (3) we can set workspace_limit to 256MiB and enable buffer reuse. Quick config (runtime):
```
kernel_options: {prefer_fused: true, workspace_limit_mb: 256, reuse_buffers: true}
```
Sam: Also reduce max_batch_tokens from 8192 -> 4096 to prevent large combined workspaces. That should drop peak per-request allocations.
Alex: I'm going to apply a hotfix: set workspace_limit_mb=256 and max_batch_tokens=4096 on r32-52 and enable reuse_buffers. Rolling restart of 4 replicas.
deploy-bot: Started rolling restart: r32-52 replicas (4) by Alex at 2026-03-17T10:28:00Z :rocket:
oncall-bot: Paging oncall: possible degraded latency for some routes during restart.
Maria: Meanwhile we should open a short fallback route rule: route requests with seq_len>2048 or tokens>4000 to model:small-quant-v2.
Jen: I'll push a routing rule in edge-config now. Small-quant v2 has been validated for quality on those prompts.
Sam: Also suggest adding a fragmentation metric to dashboards: "largest_free_fragment" and "free_fragment_count" per replica.
Kai: Long-term: adjust allocator to prefer merging small free blocks when contiguous (coalesce) and proactively reserve a contiguous workspace pool for large kernels.
Alex: Agreed. Next steps for postmortem: - root cause: kernel selector caused more frequent large contiguous workspace reqs + KV cache churn - short-term mitigations applied (workspace limit, buffer reuse, routing fallback, batch caps) - long-term fixes (coalescing allocator, workspace reservation, kernel backoff heuristics)
Maria: Can someone run a quick perf profile post-hotfix? check if latency regressions appear with workspace_limit lowered.
Jen: Running `perf-profile --service r32-52 --since 5m` now, will paste results.
Jen: Profile summary: p90 token latency increased 8% for small requests (due to extra copy path), but p99 for large requests dropped ~40% (fewer OOMs/failures). Memory fragmentation metrics show free_fragments down 60% after restart.
Alex: That's acceptable for now. We trade a small latency bump for stability. We'll notify customers in #incidents if user-visible errors were seen.
Sam: For the circuit breaker, suggest rules:
- if queue_depth > 40 for replica -> reject with 503
- if request_tokens > 6000 -> reject with 413
- if memory_fragmentation_index > 0.7 -> trigger routing to fallback

Maria: I'll add those to the canary circuit-breaker policy in the next 10m.
deploy-bot: Rolling restart completed: 4/4 replicas restarted successfully. No new OOMs observed in the last 5m.
oncall-bot: Incident severity: P2. Notifying stakeholders.
Alex: Great. I'll draft the incident runbook section for allocator fragmentation and add run commands and quick mitigations.
Jen: Quick commands to include in runbook:
- `watch nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.free,memory.used --format=csv -n 1`
- `curl https://telemetry/api/alloc/stats?replica=r32-52`
- `runtimectl set-config r32-52 kernel_options.workspace_limit_mb=256`
- `runtimectl set-config r32-52 batching.max_batch_tokens=4096`

Kai: Also include a note: if fallback model capacity is saturated, fallback should cascade to regionally separate pools, not just same pool.
Alex: Solid. Thanks all for quick responses. I'll post a short postmortem draft in #postmortems once we validate logs.
Maria: TY. :thumbsup:
Sam: LGTM.
Jen: 👍
Kai: :rocket:
